lines.text: The network changes. The session doesn't.
At every handoff, the camera flies to where the new link comes from, then rides it home.
Its road map spots the dead zone early, and warms up satellite in time. The normal rover? Cut off.
And now, you can take the wheel. W, A, S, D.
Twenty drives each. CONTINUA kept the link, every time.
